title: MAP Enforcement Against Wholesale Partner Under Revised Policy
question: Can Atlas enforce the new MAP policy (v3.0) against Summit Outdoor for their $195 listing of the Apex Trail Boot?

contributor.name: Laura Svensson
contributor.title: Pricing Strategy Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: MAP enforcement, promotional pricing governance, wholesale vs DTC price parity, channel conflict resolution

choices: Yes — but only for the amount below the seasonal promotional MAP of $202; the $195 price is $7 below the approved promotional floor regardless of registration status
No — while v3.0 technically applies, Derek Walsh's email created an equitable estoppel situation; Atlas cannot enforce against a partner who relied on an authorized representative's explicit go-ahead
No — Summit's contract references MAP v2.1 and the MSA must be amended to enforce a newer version; Atlas has no enforcement standing until contract renewal
Yes — MAP v3.0 is effective as of April 1 and the email notification on March 15 constitutes adequate notice; Summit is in violation at $195
